primaryTextChecks.text: The children of Israel again did that which was evil in the LORD’s sight, and served the Baals, the Ashtaroth, the gods of Syria, the gods of Sidon, the gods of Moab, the gods of the children of Ammon, and the gods of the Philistines. They abandoned the LORD, and didn’t serve him.

context.text: Jair died, and was buried in Kamon.
The LORD’s anger burned against Israel, and he sold them into the hand of the Philistines and into the hand of the children of Ammon.

geographicalEvidence.reasonJa: 古代アラム系諸地域を指す広域名。士師記の用例から正確な範囲を定めることはできず、現代シリアと同じではない。

wikipediaRead.supportingParaphraseJa: 記事はアラムを聖書に現れる歴史的地域とし、アラム・ダマスカスが聖書で単に「アラム」と呼ばれることがあると説明する。現代シリア国家と同じ領域とは扱わない（131–134行）。
